info.title: CampusPulse AI API
info.description: Bilingual (EN / Jordanian Arabic / Arabizi) campus-request triage. Called only by the Next.js server with the service token; see docs/api/README.md.

post.description: Runs the main flow (SPEC §5.1) for one student message: normalize, guards, ensemble, conformal sets, decision policy, then either a clarifying question or a decision with explanation, understanding and action.

422.description: `invalid_input`: Body, query or path failed validation, or the use case raised InvalidInput.

503.description: `artifact_unavailable`: The frozen model artifact is missing or failed its checksum. `store_unavailable`: Supabase or the vector store is unreachable.

401.description: `unauthenticated`: Missing or wrong service token (or a bad webhook signature).

x-side-effects: inserts `requests`, `predictions` and `events` rows; upserts the request embedding into the `requests` vector collection
decided/human_review: opens a ticket (Supabase + Linear issue), may book an advisor slot, sends allow-listed email and in-app notifications (`outbox` rows), may create or attach to an incident
human_review, out_of_scope, distress: inserts a `review_queue` row
distress: no ticket, no email, no LLM call

post.description: Applies the student's answer (an option chip or free text) to a request in `needs_clarification` and re-runs the core (LD-29). Returns the same shape as /v1/triage.

AblationRowOut.title: AblationRowOut
AblationRowOut.description: One ablation arm (P2.9), scored on the same rows as the full system.

provisional.title: Provisional
provisional.description: True for `needs_review` items: ticket labelled unconfirmed.

incident_id.title: Incident Id
incident_id.description: Set when the request was merged into an incident.

ArtifactOut.title: ArtifactOut
ArtifactOut.description: The frozen model artifact in use.

BenchmarkRowOut.title: BenchmarkRowOut
BenchmarkRowOut.description: One benchmark cell (SPEC §6.2). Null metrics = `n/a` (no key) or `cut` (M3).

BookingOut.title: BookingOut
BookingOut.description: An advisor slot booked for Academic Support x high (UD-1). Advisors are fictional.

CalibrationOut.title: CalibrationOut
CalibrationOut.description: Calibration of one target (ECE + reliability bins).

CategoryOut.title: CategoryOut
CategoryOut.description: Category decision: the label, its probability and the conformal set.

ClarificationOut.title: ClarificationOut
ClarificationOut.description: The clarifying question asked when the request is ambiguous, in the request language.

ClarifyRequest.title: ClarifyRequest
ClarifyRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/triage/{request_id}/clarify`: exactly one of `option_id` or `free_text`.

ConfusionOut.title: ConfusionOut
ConfusionOut.description: A confusion matrix: rows = true label, columns = predicted, in `labels` order.

CounterfactualOut.title: CounterfactualOut
CounterfactualOut.description: The smallest single-token deletion that flips category or priority.

flipped.title: Flipped
flipped.description: True when category or priority changed.

CounterfactualResponse.title: CounterfactualResponse
CounterfactualResponse.description: Live counterfactual: the labels the core gives with `drop` removed.

CoverageRowOut.title: CoverageRowOut
CoverageRowOut.description: Conformal coverage for one target/dataset/language slice (approximate; effective n ~ 30).

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: The inside of every error response. `details` is free-form JSON (validation errors, request_id).

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error codes. HTTP status per code is in `ERROR_HTTP_STATUS`.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Standard error body for every non-2xx response: `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

EvidenceOut.title: EvidenceOut
EvidenceOut.description: An urgency evidence cue found in the text, e.g. `deadline_today` on `اليوم`.

ExplanationOut.title: ExplanationOut
ExplanationOut.description: Why the system decided what it did. Null when the explainer failed (flag `explanation_failed`).

ExternalRefOut.title: ExternalRefOut
ExternalRefOut.description: A ticket mirrored in an external sink (e.g. a Linear issue).

FairnessSliceOut.title: FairnessSliceOut
FairnessSliceOut.description: Macro-F1 on one language slice, with counts (LD-32, LD-33).

FaqAnswerOut.title: FaqAnswerOut
FaqAnswerOut.description: A retrieved FAQ answer (never generated). `is_demo` marks placeholder entries.

FeedbackRequest.title: FeedbackRequest
FeedbackRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/feedback`: staff confirm (both null) or correct a prediction.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Deferred actions that fired on confirmation.

artifact.title: Artifact
artifact.description: Artifact version, e.g. `v1`; null before models exist.

ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
ticket_id.description: The one incident ticket (linked to Linear).

IncidentOut.title: IncidentOut
IncidentOut.description: A Pulse incident: several reports of the same problem in one building.

LocationIn.title: LocationIn
LocationIn.description: A building (and optional room) the student picked on the map.

active_examples.title: Active Examples
active_examples.description: Active memory size after the write.

MemoryWriteOut.title: MemoryWriteOut
MemoryWriteOut.description: The live-memory example written by a staff correction.

ask_rate_is_proxy.title: Ask Rate Is Proxy
ask_rate_is_proxy.description: True while the rate is the P2 proxy (LD-24).

MetricsResponse.title: MetricsResponse
MetricsResponse.description: `GET /v1/metrics`: offline reports (`reports/*.json`) plus live router/memory/red-team stats.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Set for memory items ('learned N s ago').

NeighborOut.title: NeighborOut
NeighborOut.description: A similar past example (training data or a staff correction in live memory).

PriorityOut.title: PriorityOut
PriorityOut.description: Priority decision: label, probability, conformal set and the evidence that drove it.

ProblemClusterOut.title: ProblemClusterOut
ProblemClusterOut.description: A recurring problem (UD-6): semantically similar requests in one category/building.

RedTeamFailureOut.title: RedTeamFailureOut
RedTeamFailureOut.description: A red-team item that failed its pass rule.

styles.title: Styles
styles.description: Subset of: fake_urgency, calm_emergency, typos, arabizi, mixed_language, two_issues, very_long, injection, off_topic, distress_adjacent. Null = all.

RedTeamRunRequest.title: RedTeamRunRequest
RedTeamRunRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/redteam/run`. `n` is capped by Settings `REDTEAM_MAX_N` (200).

ReindexResponse.title: ReindexResponse
ReindexResponse.description: Result of re-embedding a vector collection.

ScorecardOut.title: ScorecardOut
ScorecardOut.description: A red-team run's scorecard (pass rates in [0, 1]).

SimulateResponse.title: SimulateResponse
SimulateResponse.description: A started simulated burst. All its requests carry `simulated=true`.

TicketOut.title: TicketOut
TicketOut.description: A CampusPulse ticket (system of record in Supabase).

policy_path.title: Policy Path
policy_path.description: DecisionPolicy rule ids in evaluation order, e.g. `a_gibberish`..`f_human` (P3.1).

clarified.title: Clarified
clarified.description: Whether a clarification answer was applied.

text.title: Text
text.description: The student's message (or the confirmed voice transcript).

student_alias.title: Student Alias
student_alias.description: Pseudonymous alias such as `demo-17`; never a name.

understood_as.title: Understood As
understood_as.description: Arabic transliteration shown for Arabizi input (LD-25).

TriageResponse.title: TriageResponse
TriageResponse.description:
Response of `POST /v1/triage` and `POST /v1/triage/{request_id}/clarify` (SPEC §7 + LD-25 + UD-10).

Which keys are null depends on `status` (docs/api/README.md › Status values).

UnderstandingOut.title: UnderstandingOut
UnderstandingOut.description: Structured understanding (UD-10). Never changes the decided labels.

WebhookAck.title: WebhookAck
WebhookAck.description: Result of an inbound sink webhook. `accepted=false` = ignored event (not ours).

ServiceToken.description: `Authorization: Bearer <AI_SERVICE_TOKEN>`, sent only by the Next.js server.
